phase: Phase 9 — Governance Assurance and Release Readiness

conditions: Finding F-A11Y-1: the accessibility dimension is PROVEN on this host by the browserless full-suite (playwright project "accessibility-full-suite"), which verifies the WCAG 2.2 AA affordances present in the exact shipped rendered markup (AR-001..AR-008, SC-014) each with a red witness so the oracle is non-vacuous. The full-fidelity axe-core scan against a real Chromium is a STRICTLY-ADDITIONAL CI enhancement (verify-release.ts classifies it `additional-fidelity`, non-release-blocking); it re-renders the same affordances at higher fidelity and should still be run in CI (TC_HAS_BROWSER=1) as defence-in-depth (owner: Accessibility Reviewer).
reviews.statement: The browserless full-suite verifies the WCAG 2.2 AA affordances (AR-001..AR-008, SC-014) that appear in the exact rendered markup that ships, each with a red witness so it is non-vacuous — this proves the accessibility dimension to a real pass on any host. The full-fidelity browser axe-core scan is a strictly-additional CI-only rendering of those same affordances; running it is defence-in-depth, not a precondition of release, because the dimension is already proven.

conditions: Finding F-ISO-1: clause identifiers to be re-confirmed against the exact published standard editions before any external assessment (owner: Compliance Reviewer).
reviews.statement: ISO/IEC 42001/42005/42006 audit-readiness packages map shipped controls to clause identifiers with paraphrased obligations; no licensed text is reproduced and no certification is claimed.

Validation manifests verify (schema HMAC, requirement coverage, checkpoint signature, evidence-digest binding); the aggregate quickstart run is signed; the governed evidence inventory is tamper-evident and self-consistent.
Every requirements-quality checklist is dispositioned with owners and independent reviewers; requirement→task→test→evidence traceability is complete; primary role journeys complete unaided.

conditions: Finding F-ECO-1: per-source numeric freshness/lag alert thresholds to be tuned at first adapter activation (owner: Operations Reviewer).
reviews.statement: Operations and disaster-recovery runbooks cover triage, dead-letters, reconciliation, audit freeze, and a four-hour RTO with zero committed loss; chaos suite proves safe degradation.
STRIDE threat model with residual-risk register; tamper detection is fail-closed; tenant isolation enforced; supply-chain SBOM/licenses/vulnerabilities are clean with narrow, owned exceptions.
